renders._yaml:
- component: card
  title: Retained cells
  description: |-
    The hero number is the median count of cells QCatch keeps after cell calling, and the box shows the quartiles over samples. It answers how many cells each sample yields for analysis.
    How to read: compare it with the cells you aimed to capture. A much lower count points to a stringent call or a failed capture, so open the table for the processed cells.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/COMBINE-lab/QCatch/main/README.md
  column: retained_cells
  aggregation: median
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  caption: median, with quartiles
  headline: true

- component: card
  title: Mapping rate
  description: |-
    The hero number is the average percent of reads that map to the reference, and the gauge shows it on a 0 to 100 scale with the lowest and highest sample beside it. It answers how much of the sequencing the reference explains.
    How to read: a high rate means the reads match the reference. A low rate points to a wrong reference or a wrong chemistry, so check the index first.
    Note: QCatch publishes no pass mark for the mapping rate, so the gauge is a scale and not a threshold.
  column: mapping_rate_pct
  aggregation: average
  aggregations:
  - min
  - max
  secondary_layout: gauge
  coverage_max: 100.0
  caption: average, of 100 percent

- component: card
  title: Sequencing saturation
  description: |-
    The hero number is the average sequencing saturation in percent, the share of reads that repeat an already observed molecule, with the lowest and highest sample beside it. It answers whether more sequencing would reveal more molecules.
    How to read: a high saturation means extra reads mostly re-count known molecules, so deeper sequencing adds little. A low saturation means the library is not yet exhausted and more reads would still add information.
    Note: QCatch publishes no pass mark for saturation, so the gauge is a scale and not a threshold.
  column: sequencing_saturation_pct
  aggregation: average
  aggregations:
  - min
  - max
  secondary_layout: gauge
  coverage_max: 100.0
  caption: average, of 100 percent

- component: table
  title: QC summary
  description: |-
    Each row is a sample with the retained and processed cells, the mean reads, the median UMIs and genes per retained cell, the genes detected, the mapping rate and the sequencing saturation. It answers the numbers behind the cards.
    How to read: compare the retained with the processed cells to see how strict the cell calling was, and the median genes per cell to judge the depth of each cell.
